title: Code that depends on measured layout needs a browser test, not jsdom
rule: When a component's behavior depends on a measured size (offsetWidth, clientWidth, getBoundingClientRect), test it in Playwright and assert the measured result. Under jsdom these sizes are 0, so a Vitest test passes whether or not the logic works.
rationale: E41.1 (#447): the shrink-to-fit in CardLiveText reads offsetWidth; under jsdom it stayed at 1, and no test failed when it was broken.
